title: How to use the guide
html:
The main thing is the steps below, in order. The 3D map is only to see in advance where to go. Have you performed Umrah before? Choose “Done it before” at the top — only the actions and du'as will stay, without explanations. A second Umrah on this trip, already from Makkah — “Another one on this trip”: steps 1–5 will show the miqat outside the Haram boundary. Umrah for someone else — “Umrah for another person (badal)” in the same place.

Tap a step to see what to do and which du'as to read. Done? Tap “Done”. Your marks are saved on the phone and work without internet.

Labels by the Hanafi madhhab

Fard · shart

The foundation. Without it there is no Umrah — missing it cannot be made up in any way.

Wajib

Obligatory. If you miss it, the Umrah is valid, but expiation is needed (usually a dam sacrifice).

Sunnah

The Prophet ﷺ did this. It brings reward; missing it needs no expiation, but the reward is lost.

Mustahabb

Praiseworthy, good adab. If you do it — good; if not — no sin.

Mubah

Permitted: no reward and no sin. For example, changing into a clean ihram, a money belt, an umbrella.

Makruh

Tanzihi — undesirable, better not to do it, but no sin (worldly talk during tawaf). Tahrimi — nearly forbidden, this is a sin, although the Umrah is valid (praying while the sun is rising; leaving a wajib on purpose).

Haram

Forbidden, a sin. In ihram these are the “Ihram prohibitions”: breaking one requires expiation, and breaking one on purpose also requires repentance.

The labels are shown on the steps. How to label each action is under review by a scholar of fiqh.

How to read a du'a

Example
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
Bismillah — transliteration
“In the name of Allah” — translation of the meaning
Source: the Quran (ayah) or a hadith collection
⚑ To check — a point on which scholars hold different opinions.

title: Ihram prohibitions
html:
Sewn clothingsocks, underwear, fitted clothes
Head and facedo not cover · an umbrella is allowed
Perfume and scentssoap, shampoo, cream
Hair and nailsdo not cut, do not shave
Huntingdo not kill even insects
Intimacyand everything that leads to it
Swearing and arguingrudeness, gossip
Morewhat is allowed

Allowed

  • A shower without scented soap, a watch, glasses, a belt, a wallet, a backpack, medicines, a toothbrush.
  • Changing and washing the ihram.
Morebroke a prohibition — expiations

Broke a prohibition? Expiation by degree

  • Full violation — perfume on a whole body part, sewn clothing or a covered head for a full day and night, ¼ of the head or more shaved, the nails of a whole hand or foot → dam: a sheep or a goat, within the Haram.
  • Partial — less than a day and night, less than ¼ of the head, a few nails, a little perfume → sadaqah equal to sadaqat al-fitr (≈½ sa' of wheat or its value).
  • Minor — one or two hairs, a killed insect → a small sadaqah, whatever you can spare.
  • A missed wajib (sa'i, shaving, ihram after the miqat) → dam.

If forced, or if you have no means

  • If you broke it for a valid reason (illness, heat, a wound), you may choose: dam, or sadaqah to 6 poor people, or 3 days of fasting. Fasting is open to everyone.
  • Without a valid reason, dam is obligatory. No money now? It is a debt: pay it when you have the means. The sacrifice can be paid for through the official Saudi project “Adahi”.
  • If it happened out of forgetfulness or ignorance, Hanafis also require expiation, but there is no sin.
⚑ To check: the amounts and cases of expiation — check with a scholar of Hanafi fiqh. Do not panic: almost any violation can be put right.
